facts.claim: On the installed 1.5.1 (13), Set up (Codex) and Repair (Claude Code) succeed, but Test Connection records verified-stale ('no evidence has been persisted yet'): the helper's --self-check takes freshness only from persisted_state_as_of, which the retired file scanner leaves null since 1.5.0, while the same answer carries capacity_history.newest_sample_at minutes old.

MonitoringLifecycleController records every sample into CapacityRing (a fine row at least every 4 of the default 5 minutes, one hourly row per clock hour), so the newest capacity sample stays well inside the one-hour stale threshold while Monitoring runs at default settings.

findings.claim: REQ-703's supported installer is the app, whose Test Connection never verifies since the scanner retired; no task owned the self-check.
findings.change: Add TASK-716 (helper self-check freshness from capacity samples) contributing to OUTCOME-710 and validated by GATE-719; GATE-719's AC-02 now also requires Test Connection to verify both clients.
findings.rationale: Found by GATE-719 on the installed candidate; the user asked for every bug fixed before 1.5.1 ships.

summary: Adds TASK-716 so the app's connection test reads Monitoring's capacity samples; GATE-719 now also requires both clients to verify. The 1.5.1 build 13 candidate is superseded; GATE-719 re-runs on the new input.
limitations: A user who sets the sample interval above an hour still sees stale between samples; the threshold is unchanged by design.
